ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: African Art in the Atlantic World. This course will consider how political, economic, and cultural relationships across the Atlantic Ocean have shaped artistic practices, both within Africa and throughout the African diaspora, from the early modern period to the present day. Our topics will include: arts of trade and diplomacy between Africa and Europe during the Age of Discovery; African artistic responses to the trans-Atlantic slave trade; transmissions of African aesthetics across the Atlantic Ocean to the Caribbean, Latin America, and the United States; sacred arts of the Black Atlantic, such as those associated with Santería, Vodun, and Carnival; African and diasporic artists’ contributions to global modernist movements; and contemporary artists’ engagement with issues of heritage and diaspora.
